ops.title: codex-ask daemon has been dead since 2026-08-29; agent-inject pays 662ms per tool call to dial it
ops.description:
~/.cc-codex-ask/daemon.log: dead since 2026-08-29 19:17:25 after repeated 'trust verifier self-probe failed ... run verifier child: worker: timed out' — the self-probe spawns a verifier child which times out on this exec-taxed host. On-disk daemon was 1.8.4 while the plugin is 1.11.0; no LaunchAgent exists. Explains the codex-ask-channel MCP connect failure.

AgentInjectCmd (cc-interact@v0.34.0/cmd/agent.go:53-90) calls NewClient without EnsureCurrentIfRunning, so it can never revive the daemon. 100% of agent-inject's cost is currently waste, and nothing caches the absence.

(a) rebuild+restart — daemonkit 0.23.0 may already fix the verifier timeout. (b) regardless, cache observed absence for a few seconds.

ops.text: daemon runs current version under a LaunchAgent, or absence is cached
AgentInjectCmd no longer dials a known-dead socket on every tool call
